1	"""FinalAgent: bargains in SUPPLIER-VALUE space with lever bundles, not on unit price.
2	
3	Why: the supplier prices every sheet by what it is worth to it in cash (price at its standard terms, minus
4	the cost of the payment days we ask), and terms such as contract months, lead time or an index clause are
5	free for it. So we (1) fix the VALUE we offer each round, (2) pick the lever combination that is cheapest
6	for US at that value (long payment, short lead time, ...), and set the price that gives exactly that value.
7	- Value schedule: anchor at 0.76 x the value of their sheet, then close 55% of the gap, then jump to the
8	  fixed point of "their ask falls by g x our rise" (g estimated, default 0.25): the ask freezes at a random
9	  early round, so two big moves beat ten small steps. A sheet above their value x (1 - tol) is accepted at
10	  our price, so we only go above it in the last two messages.
11	- Sheets: the lowest-C bundle, the lowest-C bundle with payment <= their standard (suppliers that refuse
12	  long terms), their own terms re-priced (pure price move). Cheapest for us first: they take the first of equal value.
13	- Closing: a supplier sheet meets us when its C is no more than our cheapest sheet's C.
14	- A silent thread is skipped after `max_asks` messages; never walk away while a supplier is alive.
15	"""
16	
17	import itertools
18	import math
19	
20	from ..cost import closing_terms, complete_offer, must_haves_ok, supplier_value, total_cost
21	from ..docs import standard_terms
22	from ..guard import satisfy_must_haves
23	from ..play import ENDED, closing_move, latest, live_threads, moves_left
24	from .reciprocal import (
25	    ReciprocalAgent,
26	    _c_alt,
27	    _live,
28	    _mine,
29	    _pinned,
30	    _sup,
31	    _tick,
32	    _valid,
33	    case_c_open,
34	    closing_accept,
35	)
36	from .reciprocal import _sheets as their_sheets
37	
38	QUOTE_ASK = "Could you please send us your quote?"
39	BODY = (
40	    "Thank you for your offer. Please find our proposal in the attached term sheets; each of them works for us, "
41	    "please pick the one that suits you best."
42	)
43	R_SUP, STD_PD, TOL = 0.074, 30, 0.012  # fitted median supplier rate, its payment days, tolerance
44	ANCHOR, JUMP = 0.76, 0.55
45	G_DEFAULT, G_MIN, G_MAX, MIN_STEP = 0.25, 0.1, 0.8, 0.01
46	MAX_COMBOS, MAX_SHEETS = 3000, 3
47	
48	
49	def _priced(case, events, std):
50	    """[(C, sheet)] of the thread's standing sheets, must-haves ignored."""
51	    return _valid(case, events, std, math.inf, musts=False)
52	
53	
54	def _std_full(case, events):
55	    """The supplier's complete standard terms: its quote PDF, its payment days (default 30), gaps from the plan."""
56	    std = standard_terms(events)
57	    pd = std.get("payment_days") or STD_PD
58	    full = closing_terms(case, {"unit_price": None}, std)
59	    full = {**full, **{k: v for k, v in std.items() if v is not None}, "payment_days": pd}
60	    return full
61	
62	
63	def _value(case, std_full, terms):
64	    return supplier_value(case, terms, {"standard": std_full, "interest_rate": R_SUP})
65	
66	
67	def _lowest_value(case, std_full, sheets):
68	    vals = [_value(case, std_full, s["terms"]) for s in sheets if (s.get("terms") or {}).get("unit_price") is not None]
69	    return min(vals, default=None)
70	
71	
72	def _target(case, events, std_full):
73	    """The value (to the supplier) we offer this round, or None without a priced sheet of theirs."""
74	    theirs = [_lowest_value(case, std_full, m["term_sheets"]) for m in _sup(events) if m.get("term_sheets")]
75	    theirs = [v for v in theirs if v is not None]
76	    if not theirs:
77	        return None
78	    a = theirs[-1]
79	    mine = [m["term_sheets"][0]["terms"] for m in _mine(events) if m.get("term_sheets")]
80	    ours = [_value(case, std_full, t) for t in mine if t.get("unit_price")]
81	    tick = _tick(a)
82	    if not ours:
83	        o = ANCHOR * a
84	    elif len(ours) == 1:
85	        o = ours[-1] + JUMP * (a - ours[-1])
86	    else:

88	        if len(theirs) >= 2 and (fall := theirs[-2] - theirs[-1]) > 0 and (rise := ours[-1] - ours[-2]) > 0:
89	            g = min(G_MAX, max(G_MIN, fall / rise))

91	        o = min(a - tick, max(o_star, ours[-1] + max(MIN_STEP * a, tick)))

98	    """Pinned fields: the parent's, plus an index clause the supplier repeated twice while we asked otherwise."""
99	    pins = _pinned(events)

101	    mine = [m for m in _mine(events) if m.get("term_sheets")]

108	def _reduce(opts, centre, k):
109	    """At most k options: the one at `centre`, the extremes, then the closest to it."""
110	    if len(opts) <= k:
111	        return opts
112	    nums = all(isinstance(o, int | float) and not isinstance(o, bool) for o in opts)
113	    if not nums:
114	        return opts[:k]

122	        self.anchor, self.max_asks = anchor, max_asks
123	
124	    def _ask(self, case, sid):
125	        return {"supplier_id": sid, "message": {"subject": case.get("title", "Our enquiry"), "body": QUOTE_ASK}}
126	
127	    def _unheard(self, threads):
128	        """A thread that never answered and has had fewer than max_asks of our messages, or None."""
129	        return next((s for s, ev in threads.items() if not _sup(ev) and len(_mine(ev)) < self.max_asks), None)
130	
131	    def _close(self, case, quoted):
132	        """Accept the best acceptable sheet; else rescue a priced sheet that only breaks a must-have by
133	        sending it with the must-haves fixed; else walk away (only when nothing else can be done)."""
134	        if not live_threads(quoted):
135	            return {"supplier_id": next(iter(quoted), None), "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
136	        move = closing_move(case, quoted)
137	        if move["message"].get("action", {}).get("type") != "walk_away":
138	            return move
139	        c_alt, c_open, best = _c_alt(case), case_c_open(case, quoted), None
140	        for sid, ev in quoted.items():
141	            if latest(ev).get("status") in ENDED or moves_left(case, ev) < 1:
142	                continue
143	            std = standard_terms(ev)
144	            base = {k: std[k] for k in case["negotiable"] if k in std}
145	            sent = [x["terms"] for m in _mine(ev) for x in m.get("term_sheets") or []]
146	            for _, sh in _priced(case, ev, std):
147	                fixed = complete_offer(case, satisfy_must_haves(case, {**base, **sh["terms"]}, std))
148	                if not must_haves_ok(case, fixed, std) or fixed in sent:
149	                    continue
150	                if (c := total_cost(case, fixed, std)) < c_alt and c <= c_open:
151	                    best = min(best or (c, sid, fixed), (c, sid, fixed), key=lambda x: x[0])
152	        if best is None:
153	            return move
154	        _, sid, fixed = best
155	        body = "We can accept your price with the terms below; please confirm."
156	        message = {"subject": case.get("title", "Our proposal"), "body": body, "term_sheets": [{"terms": fixed}]}
157	        return {"supplier_id": sid, "message": message}

160	        quoted = {s: ev for s, ev in threads.items() if _sup(ev)}
161	        if not _live(threads):  # nothing to answer: ask a thread that never wrote, else give up
162	            if (sid := self._unheard(threads)) is not None:
163	                return self._ask(case, sid)
164	            return {"supplier_id": next(iter(threads), None), "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
165	        if accept := closing_accept(case, quoted, by_cost=True):
166	            return accept
167	        live = [s for s in _live(threads) if moves_left(case, threads[s]) >= 1]
168	        open_ = [s for s in live if latest(threads[s]).get("status") not in ("final_offer", "agreed")]
169	
170	        def silent(s):  # no priced sheet and already asked enough: skip it, never walk away from it
171	            ev = threads[s]
172	            return not _priced(case, ev, standard_terms(ev)) and len(_mine(ev)) >= self.max_asks

175	        if not open_:

177	                return self._ask(case, sid)
